item.title: Matsuyama Ramen and Imabari Yakibuta Tama — Guide
item.description: Beyond its castles and hot springs, Ehime has satisfying local noodle and rice dishes worth seeking out. Matsuyama has its own everyday ramen culture, with local shops serving comforting soy- or pork-based bowls that make an easy, cheap meal between sights. Imabari, the port city at the Shikoku end of the Shimanami Kaido, is known for ‘yakibuta tamago meshi’ — a hearty local dish of sliced braised pork (yakibuta) and egg over rice, rich and savoury, a favourite of cyclists and locals alike.
